classes.name: APIHeaderSection_MakeHeader
classes.summary: This class allows to consult and prepare/edit data stored in a Step Model Header.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Prepares a new MakeHeader from scratch.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Prepares a MakeHeader from the content of a StepModel See IsDone to know if the Header is well defined.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment: Cancels the former definition and gives a FileName To be used when a Model has no well defined Header.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if all data have been defined (see also HasFn, HasFs, HasFd).

instanceMethods.name: Apply
instanceMethods.comment: Creates an empty header for a new STEP model and allows the header fields to be completed.

instanceMethods.name: NewModel
instanceMethods.comment: Builds a Header, creates a new StepModel, then applies the Header to the StepModel The Schema Name is taken from the Protocol (if it inherits from {@link StepData | `StepData`}, else it is left in blanks).

instanceMethods.name: HasFn
instanceMethods.comment: Checks whether there is a file_name entity. Returns True if there is one.

instanceMethods.name: FnValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the file_name entity. Returns an empty entity if the file_name entity is not initialized.

instanceMethods.name: Name
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the name attribute for the file_name entity.

instanceMethods.name: TimeStamp
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of the time_stamp attribute for the file_name entity.

instanceMethods.name: AuthorValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of the name attribute for the file_name entity.

instanceMethods.name: NbAuthor
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of values for the author attribute in the file_name entity.

instanceMethods.name: OrganizationValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of attribute organization for the file_name entity.

instanceMethods.name: NbOrganization
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of values for the organization attribute in the file_name entity.

instanceMethods.name: PreprocessorVersion
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the name of the preprocessor_version for the file_name entity.

instanceMethods.name: Authorisation
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of the authorization attribute for the file_name entity.

instanceMethods.name: HasFs
instanceMethods.comment: Checks whether there is a file_schema entity. Returns True if there is one.

instanceMethods.name: FsValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the file_schema entity. Returns an empty entity if the file_schema entity is not initialized.

instanceMethods.name: SchemaIdentifiersValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of the schema_identifier attribute for the file_schema entity.

instanceMethods.name: NbSchemaIdentifiers
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of values for the schema_identifier attribute in the file_schema entity.

instanceMethods.name: AddSchemaIdentifier
instanceMethods.comment: Add a subname of schema (if not yet in the list).

instanceMethods.name: HasFd
instanceMethods.comment: Checks whether there is a file_description entity. Returns True if there is one.

instanceMethods.name: FdValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the file_description entity. Returns an empty entity if the file_description entity is not initialized.

instanceMethods.name: DescriptionValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of the description attribute for the file_description entity.

instanceMethods.name: NbDescription
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of values for the file_description entity in the STEP file header.

instanceMethods.name: ImplementationLevel
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of the implementation_level attribute for the file_description entity.
